[[File:EelCages-Prisoners.png|thumb|right|250px|Anakin Skywalker and Kit Fisto imprisoned in eel cages]]
An '''eel cage''' was an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Torture/Legends|torture]] device in which four [[Mon Cala eel/Legends|electric eels]] were restrained by a set of [[Binders/Legends|binders]] to create a restraining device. The prisoner was placed inside the cage, and the electricity created by the eels prevented them from leaving. If the interrogator forced one of the eels inward, it struck the prisoner and sent a painful electric charge surging through them.<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] used this device to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in an attempt to discover the whereabouts of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]], [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]].<ref name="Prisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
The eel cage first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Prisoners]]." Although not identified by name during that episode,<ref name="Prisoners" /> they were described by the name "eel cage" on concept art that appeared on the official [[StarWars.com]] website after the episode first broadcast.<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/prisoners-episode-guide|text="Prisoners" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
